events.name: Christmas Lights Car
events.description: Your own car parked in the snow at blue hour, wrapped in warm string lights, snow falling, a lit-up house behind: the holiday card shot, moving.

events.name: Jisoo Addicted Dance
events.description: Two friends dance to Jisoo's "ADDICTED" in a bright white hallway with a warm light strip and dark wooden doors, filmed on a handheld phone: one in a brown leather cropped top and light blue jeans, one in a light grey long-sleeve top and black trousers, taking turns at the lens, leaning on each other's shoulders laughing, then finishing side by side with the same hand moves at the face.

events.name: Leo Cheers Meme
events.description: You're Gatsby at the party: you look up into the camera, then raise the champagne coupe as the fireworks go off.

events.name: Mabel Matiz Umrumdışı
events.description: In a cream music classroom with a row of ukuleles on the wall, the singer stands upright at a black keyboard and sings "Umrumdışı" to the ceiling, head tipped back, while the pianist in a black wristwatch conducts with both hands, then plays the keys and looks up at the singer.
